statements.notes: Milk Thistle X is a blend of premium herbal extracts designed to promote healthy liver function. Utilizing standardized extracts of milk thistle, artichoke, and licorice, this formula provides guaranteed levels of key compounds found in each of these ingredients.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food & Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Recommendation: Take 2 capsules three times daily.

Warning: Do not use this product if you are allergic to plants of the Asteraceae (Compositae) family, including ragweed, are pregnant, or nursing, if you have a bile duct obstruction, high blood pressure, or cardiovascular disease.
